---
title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Emma Acedo"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```
```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true

income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Median household income",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income in Texas",
    subtitle = "By county, 2020",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS)"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_001", "B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE,
  summary_var = "B15003_001"
)
```
```{r} 
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    percent = 100 * sum(estimate[variable != "B15003_001"]) / unique(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(NAME, percent), y = percent, fill = percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher by state-level geography (2020)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of adults 25 and over",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
#| message: false

age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = estimate
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(rank(-population) <= 5, NAME, "")),
    size = 3,
    vjust = -0.7,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median age vs. county population in California (2020)",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
